name: Alter Vault
description: Multi-user identity, OAuth grants, HITL approvals, and per-user audit for OpenClaw deployments — backed by Alter Vault.

agentApiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the agent API key (alter_ak_…; legacy alter_key_…). The plugin reads process.env[agentApiKeyEnv] at boot. The KEY itself is NEVER stored in plugin config — that would put it in `openclaw plugins config` output.

appApiKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the app API key. Used for end-user sign-in, listGrants, and revokeGrant via the App SDK chokepoint proxy.

stateHmacSecretEnv.description: Name of the env var holding a random 64-hex string used to HMAC-sign the Connect state parameter.

dbEncryptionKeyEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the AES-256-GCM key (64 hex chars = 32 bytes) for at-rest JWT encryption. Validated for length at startup. Rotated via `openclaw alter db-rotate-key`.

walletBaseUrl.description: Alter Wallet base URL — surfaced via /alter wallet.

publicBaseUrl.description: Single public URL for the OpenClaw deployment (e.g. https://openclaw.example.com). The plugin mounts /alter/connect/cb under this. MUST be registered as the allowed Connect return URL in your Alter app.

channelHashSalt.description: Per-deployment random string mixed into channel_user_id hashes used in logs (`sha256(salt + ':' + channel_user_id)[:16]`) so the log hashes aren't a globally-shared rainbow-table target. 32+ random hex chars recommended.

rateLimitInputTokensPerDay.description: Per-user daily cap on LLM input tokens. Tool calls refuse when exceeded. Counter increments post-call (per-day caps tolerate the burst; there is no per-minute cap).

rateLimitOutputTokensPerDay.description: Per-user daily cap on LLM output tokens.
